field.language.tooltip: Auto-detect when empty; e.g. zh, en, pol
field.secondary_languages.tooltip: Possible language codes, comma-separated; empty means unrestricted
field.transcript_edit.tooltip: Leave empty to disable; up to 2000 chars. The server edits each confirmed segment and final output waits for the edit; if the edit is missing it fails and allows retry.
field.transcript_edit.description: Raises the base transcription cost by 30%; each confirmed segment bills at least 10 s
field.enable_ddc.tooltip: Removes filler words, repeated starts, and disfluencies; does not affect the real-time transcript
field.enable_keyterms.tooltip: Uses the enabled hotwords; up to 50 entries, 20 chars each
field.enable_keyterms.description: Enabling raises the base transcription cost by 20%
field.commit_strategy.tooltip: Controls when each transcript segment is confirmed without affecting the live display. Manual: commit the current segment when recording ends; VAD: the server confirms segments on pauses. Both wait for the final result after recording ends.
field.filter_background_audio.tooltip: Reduce false recognition from nearby speech and ambient noise
field.vad_silence_threshold_secs.tooltip: How long a pause confirms the current segment; 0.3–3 s
field.vad_threshold.tooltip: 0.1–0.9; lower detects speech more easily. Affects server-side VAD only
field.min_speech_duration_ms.tooltip: Filters sounds that are too short; 50–2000 ms
field.min_silence_duration_ms.tooltip: Minimum silence that counts as a speech break; 50–2000 ms, distinct from segment silence

hotwords.title: Hotwords
hotwords.description: Hotwords improve recognition of specific terms. The enabled table is the default and is passed in automatically; models that do not support hotwords can append them to LLM polishing (Audio models > Custom configuration > Recognition boost). Add built-in tables from "Built-in hotword tables" as custom tables.
